svg.title: FastRider · independent tap cycles · design draft 46
svg.desc: Design only. Tap live power block to cycle 3s and 10s averages. Tap the right-middle statistics block to cycle current LAP and whole Ride, titled All. Tap chart header or plot to cycle 5m, 20m, All. Modes are independent, with no data reset; history All covers the entire Ride regardless of statistics scope. Remaining course values and all sensor values are illustrative. Current implementation defaults to 3s / All statistics / 5m. Each native lap boundary selects the newest lap. Statistics average power uses bold type. Black 3 by 10 px ticks show position within the original numbered heart-rate or power zone.
